51:     (S0 : Set α) (hS0 : S0 ⊆ S) (H0 : C S0) (H1 : ∀ s ⊂ S, C s → ∃ a ∈ S \ s, C (insert a s)) :

59:   exact ⟨⟨insert a s.1, insert_subset ha1 s.2⟩, Set.ssubset_insert ha2, ha'⟩
